selinux_mode.description: Default mode for SELinux at boot. 'enforcing' blocks policy violations, 'permissive' logs but does not block, 'disabled' turns off SELinux entirely.

selinux_policy_type.description: The SELinux policy type to apply. Common values: 'targeted' (protects network daemons), 'mls' (Multi-Level Security, stricter), 'minimum' (subset of targeted).

selinux_bootloader_enforce.description: Whether to enforce SELinux at boot via kernel command-line (yes/no). Deprecated on many modern systems; prefer using kernel参数 (e.g., `selinux=1 enforcing=1`) or `setenforce`.
